messages:
emma: Quick heads up 3: we just cut community-adapters v0.2.0 to GH. :tada:

emma: repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-adapters

emma: Highlights: new maintainer guide, added adapters for HuggingFace Hub models, Redwood Hosted + Dedicated examples, and a templates/ folder for contribs.

release-bot: release published community-adapters v0.2.0 3: changelog: maintainer checklist, HF adapter, improved README, added CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.

owen: awesome. does the HF adapter support private HF repos (token auth)?

emma: yes 3: HF_TOKEN env supported; docs show how to set in CI and for Private deployments.

nina: can we get a short onboarding doc for new maintainers? would help reduce triage noise.

emma: already added MAINTAINERS.md + issue templates for triage and release.

sam: would be good to have a small community meeting to onboard maintainers and review the release process.

emma: planning a 30-min maintainer orientation next Thu 10:00 PT 3: agenda: repo structure, release checklist, security/PII checklist, and who to ping for Console integrations. Link will be posted in #devex.

irene: I'll volunteer to own weekly triage for the first month. also will propose a labeling scheme for eval vs infra issues.

owen: nice. can we include a note in the release about compatibility matrix for Redwood runtime versions? some customers run older Dedicated stacks.

emma: good call 3: added COMPATIBILITY.md with supported runtime versions and a fallback strategy.

release-bot: CI: all checks passed on main for v0.2.0.

sam: I'll write a short community post and cross-post to the forum + Twitter.

emma: thanks all. If you want maintainer access, reply here or open an issue with your GitHub handle. :sparkles:
